exam.title: REPLACE — IELTS Academic Writing
exam.description: Academic Writing: Task 1 visual report (150 words) and Task 2 essay (250 words), 60 minutes.

sections.title: Academic Writing
sections.instructions: The Writing test has two tasks. You have 60 minutes. Task 2 carries more weight than Task 1.

groups.title: Writing Task 1 — Visual report
groups.instructions:
You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.

REPLACE — The chart/graph/table/map/process below shows … Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.

questions.prompt: REPLACE — The chart/graph/table/map/process below shows … Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. (Write at least 150 words.)

groups.title: Writing Task 2 — Essay
groups.instructions:
You should spend about 40 minutes on this task.

Write about the following topic:

REPLACE — Essay topic. State the task type (opinion / discussion / advantages and disadvantages / problem and solution / two-part question). Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.

questions.prompt: REPLACE — Essay topic. State the task type (opinion / discussion / advantages and disadvantages / problem and solution / two-part question). Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience. (Write at least 250 words.)
